sections.heading: CONNECT EDGES
sections.content:
The `ConnectEdges` menu action (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.ConnectEdges`) and runtime utility `ConnectElements.Connect` (`UnityEngine.ProBuilder.MeshOperations.ConnectElements`) insert connecting edges between the midpoints of selected edges across adjacent faces.

1. Editor Action Contract & Activation:
- Class: `ConnectEdges : MenuAction` in namespace `UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions`.
- Properties:
  - `group`: returns `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`.
  - `iconPath`: returns `"Toolbar/Edge_Connect"`.
  - `tooltip`: configured with title `"Connect Edges"`, summary `"Inserts a new edge connecting the center points of all selected edges.  See also \"Subdivide.\""`, and shortcut `Alt/Opt + E` (`keyCommandAlt`, `'E'`).
  - `validSelectModes`: returns `SelectMode.Edge`.
  - `enabled`: evaluated as `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCountObjectMax > 1`. Requires at least two edges selected on at least one target mesh object.
  - `hasFileMenuEntry`: returns `false`.
- Execution Pipeline (`PerformActionImplementation`):
  - Calls `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Connect Edges")` to register undo state.
  - Iterates through all selected meshes in `MeshSelection.topInternal`.
  - Executes `ConnectElements.Connect(mesh, mesh.selectedEdges, out faces, out connections, true, true)`.
  - If `connections` is returned non-null and non-empty, invokes `mesh.SetSelectedEdges(connections)` to immediately focus the newly created seam edges.
  - Invokes `mesh.Refresh()` to recalculate normals, tangents, and UVs, followed by `mesh.Optimize()`.
  - Calls `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()` to redraw the editor scene and inspector.

2. Runtime Algorithm & Edge Pairing (`ConnectElements.Connect`):
- Signature: `internal static ActionResult Connect(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IEnumerable<Edge> edges, out Face[] addedFaces, out Edge[] connections, bool returnFaces = false, bool returnEdges = false, HashSet<Face> faceMask = null)`.
- Step 1 (Edge & WingedEdge Resolution):
  - Obtains `Dictionary<int, int> lookup = mesh.sharedVertexLookup` and `lookupUV = mesh.sharedTextureLookup`.
  - Converts target `edges` to a distinct universal lookup set: `HashSet<EdgeLookup> distinctEdges = new HashSet<EdgeLookup>(EdgeLookup.GetEdgeLookup(edges, lookup))`.
  - Builds the winged-edge boundary representation: `List<WingedEdge> wings = WingedEdge.GetWingedEdges(mesh)`.
- Step 2 (Face-to-Edge Mapping & Boundary Pruning):
  - Maps selected winged edges to their owning faces in `Dictionary<Face, List<WingedEdge>> touched`.
  - Prunes non-connecting edges into `Dictionary<Face, List<WingedEdge>> affected`:
    - For each face entry where `kvp.Value.Count <= 1`, inspects `WingedEdge opp = kvp.Value[0].opposite`.
    - If `opp != null` and `touched.TryGetValue(opp.face, out opp_list)` contains `opp_list.Count > 1`, retains the single edge on this face because the adjacent face connects across this boundary seam.
    - Otherwise, single isolated edges with no connecting counterpart are discarded.

3. Face Splitting Implementations (Quads vs N-gons):
- Case A (Single Edge Insertion, `inserts == 1` or unmasked):
  - Calls `InsertVertices(Face face, List<WingedEdge> edges, List<Vertex> vertices, out ConnectFaceRebuildData data)`.
  - Walks `WingedEdge.SortEdgesByAdjacency(face)`; when an edge matches, inserts interpolated midpoint `Vertex.Mix(vertices[perimeter[i].a], vertices[perimeter[i].b], 0.5f)` into the perimeter list.
  - Rebuilds face via `AppendElements.FaceWithVertices(n_vertices, false)`. Checks surface normal dot product against original `nrm`; reverses winding with `face.Reverse()` if inverted.
- Case B (Two Edges in Face, `inserts == 2` — Quad Split):
  - Calls `ConnectEdgesInFace(Face face, WingedEdge a, WingedEdge b, List<Vertex> vertices)`.
  - Sorts face perimeter: `List<Edge> perimeter = WingedEdge.SortEdgesByAdjacency(face)`.
  - Allocates two vertex lists: `List<Vertex>[2] n_vertices` and two index lists: `List<int>[2] n_indexes`.
  - Steps through `perimeter`, adding `vertices[perimeter[i].a]` to `n_vertices[index % 2]`.
  - When reaching edge `a` or `b`, calculates midpoint `Vertex mix = Vertex.Mix(vertices[perimeter[i].a], vertices[perimeter[i].b], 0.5f)`.
  - Adds `mix` to `n_vertices[index % 2]`, increments `index++`, then adds `mix` to the new partition `n_vertices[index % 2]`.
  - Generates two new quad faces using `AppendElements.FaceWithVertices(n_vertices[i], false)`.
- Case C (Three or More Edges in Face, `inserts > 2` — N-gon Multi-Split):
  - Calls `ConnectEdgesInFace(Face face, List<WingedEdge> edges, List<Vertex> vertices)`.
  - Computes the geometric centroid of all distinct face vertices: `Vertex centroid = Vertex.Average(vertices, face.distinctIndexesInternal)`.
  - Allocates `splitCount = edges.Count` vertex lists (`List<List<Vertex>> n_vertices`) and index lists (`List<List<int>> n_indexes`).
  - Iterates through sorted `perimeter`; whenever an edge is in `edgesToSplit`, computes `mix = Vertex.Mix(...)`, appends `mix` and `centroid` to `n_vertices[index]`, advances partition `index = (index + 1) % splitCount`, and appends `mix` to the next partition.
  - Reconstructs `splitCount` new sub-faces meeting at the central `centroid` vertex.

4. Topology Finalization & New Edge Selection:
- Rebuilds mesh faces with `FaceRebuildData.Apply(results.Select(x => x.faceRebuildData), mesh, vertices, null)`.
- Clears `mesh.sharedTextures = new SharedVertex[0]` and deletes original replaced faces with `int removedVertexCount = mesh.DeleteFaces(affected.Keys).Length`.
- Reconstructs universal vertex indices via `mesh.sharedVertices = SharedVertex.GetSharedVerticesWithPositions(mesh.positionsInternal)` and invokes `mesh.ToMesh()`.
- When `returnEdges` is true, finds all edges in `results` where both endpoint vertex indices reside in the new `appended` index set (offset by `faceRebuildData.Offset() - removedVertexCount`), converts them to local edges via `EdgeLookup`, and assigns them to `connections`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, implementing edge connection requires traversing polygon loops via `MeshDataTool` or custom half-edge/winged-edge topology. Connecting 2 edges splits a quad polygon into two polygons along edge midpoints, while connecting 3+ edges requires computing the polygon centroid and generating N sub-polygons sharing the central vertex.

sections.heading: CONNECT VERTICES
sections.content:
The `ConnectVertices` menu action (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.ConnectVertices`) and runtime method `ConnectElements.Connect(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IList<int> indexes)` insert new dividing edges between selected non-adjacent vertices within a polygon face.

1. Editor Action Contract & Activation:
- Class: `ConnectVertices : MenuAction` in namespace `UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions`.
- Properties:
  - `group`: returns `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`.
  - `iconPath`: returns `"Toolbar/Vert_Connect"`.
  - `tooltip`: title `"Connect Vertices"`, summary `"Adds edges connecting all selected vertices."`, shortcut `Alt/Opt + E` (`keyCommandAlt`, `'E'`).
  - `validSelectModes`: returns `SelectMode.Vertex`.
  - `enabled`: evaluated as `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedSharedVertexCount > 1`. Requires at least two distinct shared vertex clusters selected.
  - `hasFileMenuEntry`: returns `false`.
- Execution Flow (`PerformActionImplementation`):
  - Registers undo entry via `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Connect Vertices")`.
  - Iterates over `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
    - Calls `mesh.ToMesh()`.
    - Invokes `int[] splits = mesh.Connect(mesh.selectedIndexesInternal)`.
    - If `splits` is non-null: invokes `mesh.Refresh()`, `mesh.Optimize()`, and selects the resulting vertices with `mesh.SetSelectedVertices(splits)`, returning `ActionResult.Status.Success`.
    - If `splits` is null: returns `ActionResult.Status.Failure` with message `"Failed Connecting Edges"`.
  - Invokes `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.

2. Runtime Algorithm (`ConnectElements.Connect(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IList<int> indexes)`):
- Step 1 (Input Validation & Shared Vertex Grouping):
  - Throws `ArgumentNullException` if `mesh` or `indexes` is null.
  - Computes `int sharedIndexOffset = mesh.sharedVerticesInternal.Length` and `Dictionary<int, int> lookup = mesh.sharedVertexLookup`.
  - Determines distinct shared vertex indices: `HashSet<int> distinct = new HashSet<int>(indexes.Select(x => lookup[x]))`.
  - Collects all coincident position indices across shared vertices into `HashSet<int> affected`.
- Step 2 (Per-Face Candidate Identification):
  - Scans `mesh.facesInternal`; for each face, checks its `face.distinctIndexesInternal`.
  - Groups matching vertices per face in `Dictionary<Face, List<int>> splits` via `splits.AddOrAppend(face, f[i])`.
- Step 3 (Face Splitting Dispatch):
  - For each `KeyValuePair<Face, List<int>> split in splits`:
    - If `split.Value.Count == 2`: invokes `ConnectIndexesPerFace(face, split.Value[0], split.Value[1], vertices, lookup)`.
    - If `split.Value.Count >= 3`: invokes `ConnectIndexesPerFace(face, split.Value, vertices, lookup, sharedIndexOffset++)`.
    - Assigns texture and material metadata: allocates unique `textureGroup` index if `face.textureGroup < 0`, preserves `AutoUnwrapSettings(face.uv)`, `smoothingGroup`, `manualUV`, and `submeshIndex`.
    - Collects valid splits into `successfulSplits` and `appendFaces`.

3. Internal Splitting Routines:
- Routine A (`ConnectIndexesPerFace` with 2 vertices `a` and `b`):
  - Sorts perimeter edges: `List<Edge> perimeter = WingedEdge.SortEdgesByAdjacency(face)`.
  - Checks if `perimeter[i].Contains(a) && perimeter[i].Contains(b)`: if vertices already share an existing perimeter edge, returns `null` to reject redundant connections.
  - Allocates two vertex partitions: `List<Vertex>[2] n_vertices`, `List<int>[2] n_sharedIndexes`, `List<int>[2] n_indexes`.
  - Steps through `perimeter`:
    - Adds `vertices[cur]` and `lookup[cur]` to current partition `index`.
    - When `cur == a || cur == b`: cycles partition `index = (index + 1) % 2`, and duplicates `vertices[cur]` and `lookup[cur]` into the new partition to establish the shared seam.
  - Constructs two sub-faces with `AppendElements.FaceWithVertices(n_vertices[i], false)`, assigns `f.sharedIndexes = n_sharedIndexes[i]`, checks normal dot product against original face normal `nrm`, reverses winding if inverted (`f.face.Reverse()`), and wraps into `ConnectFaceRebuildData`.
- Routine B (`ConnectIndexesPerFace` with 3+ vertices `indexes`):
  - Rejects if `indexes.Count < 3`.
  - Computes centroid of selected vertices: `Vertex center = Vertex.Average(vertices, indexes)`.
  - Allocates `splitCount = indexes.Count` partition arrays (`n_vertices`, `n_sharedIndexes`, `n_indexes`).
  - Walks `perimeter`:
    - Adds `vertices[cur]` and `lookup[cur]` to `n_vertices[index]`.
    - When `indexes.Contains(cur)`: adds `center` with `sharedIndexOffset`, cycles `index = (index + 1) % splitCount`, and adds `vertices[cur]` to the new partition.
  - Constructs `splitCount` sub-faces (skipping any with `< 3` vertices) radiating from `center`.

4. Mesh Reconstruction & Return Values:
- Rebuilds faces with `FaceRebuildData.Apply(appendFaces.Select(x => x.faceRebuildData), mesh, vertices, null)`.
- Removes old faces via `int removedVertexCount = mesh.DeleteFaces(successfulSplits).Length`.
- Re-reads `lookup = mesh.sharedVertexLookup`.
- Maps and offsets all newly created vertex indices in `newVertexIndexes.Add(lookup[appendFaces[i].newVertexIndexes[n] + (appendFaces[i].faceRebuildData.Offset() - removedVertexCount)])`.
- Calls `mesh.ToMesh()` and returns `newVertexIndexes.Select(x => mesh.sharedVerticesInternal[x][0]).ToArray()`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, connecting two vertices within a polygon corresponds to polygon diagonal slicing (`Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon` or half-edge face splitting). Connecting 3+ vertices within a polygon creates a central vertex hub connected to all selected boundary vertices.

sections.heading: BRIDGE EDGES
sections.content:
The `BridgeEdges` menu action (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.BridgeEdges`) and runtime method `AppendElements.Bridge` (`UnityEngine.ProBuilder.MeshOperations.AppendElements`) construct a new connecting polygon face between two selected edges.

1. Editor Action Contract & Activation:
- Class: `BridgeEdges : MenuAction` in namespace `UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions`.
- Properties:
  - `group`: returns `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`.
  - `iconPath`: returns `"Toolbar/Edge_Bridge"`.
  - `tooltip`: title `"Bridge Edges"`, description `"Add a new face connecting two edges."`, shortcut `Alt/Opt + B` (`keyCommandAlt`, `'B'`).
  - `validSelectModes`: returns `SelectMode.Edge`.
  - `enabled`: evaluated as `base.enabled && MeshSelection.topInternal.Any(x => x.selectedEdgeCount == 2)`. Requires exactly two selected edges on the target object.
- Execution Pipeline (`PerformActionImplementation`):
  - Returns `ActionResult.NoSelection` if `MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount < 1`.
  - Calls `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Bridge Edges")`.
  - Iterates through `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
    - Validates `mesh.selectedEdgeCount == 2`.
    - Invokes `mesh.Bridge(mesh.selectedEdges[0], mesh.selectedEdges[1], ProBuilderEditor.s_AllowNonManifoldActions)`.
    - On success: invokes `mesh.ToMesh()`, `mesh.Refresh()`, `mesh.Optimize()`.
  - If successful, calls `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()` and returns `ActionResult.Status.Success`.
  - If failed, logs warning and returns `ActionResult.Status.Failure` with message: `"Bridge Edges requires that only 2 edges be selected, and they must both only have one connecting face (non-manifold)."`.

2. Bridge Requirements & Validation (`AppendElements.Bridge`):
- Method Signature: `public static Face Bridge(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, Edge a, Edge b, bool allowNonManifoldGeometry = false)`.
- Requirement Checks:
  - Null validation: throws `ArgumentNullException("mesh")` if `mesh` is null.
  - Manifold Topology Check: when `allowNonManifoldGeometry` is false, verifies that both edges are open boundary edges with at most 1 adjacent face via `ElementSelection.GetNeighborFaces(mesh, a).Count > 1 || ElementSelection.GetNeighborFaces(mesh, b).Count > 1`. Returns `null` if violated.
  - Common Face Check: iterates over `mesh.facesInternal` and checks `mesh.IndexOf(face.edgesInternal, a) >= 0 && mesh.IndexOf(face.edgesInternal, b) >= 0`. If a face already connects both edges, logs warning `"Face already exists between these two edges!"` and returns `null`.
- Material & UV Extraction:
  - Validates edge `a` or `b` via `EdgeUtility.ValidateEdge(mesh, a, out faceAndEdge) || EdgeUtility.ValidateEdge(mesh, b, out faceAndEdge)`.
  - Inherits `uvs = new AutoUnwrapSettings(faceAndEdge.item1.uv)` and `submeshIndex = faceAndEdge.item1.submeshIndex` to match the adjacent surface.

3. Algorithm Cases:
- Case 1: Edges Share a Vertex Handle (Bridge Forms a Triangle):
  - Condition: `a.Contains(b.a, lookup) || a.Contains(b.b, lookup)`.
  - Identifies which endpoints coincide using `sharedVertices`:
    - `axbx`: `a.a` coincides with `b.a` -> vertices ordered `[a.a, a.b, b.b]`, indices `{2, 1, 0}`.
    - `axby`: `a.a` coincides with `b.b` -> vertices ordered `[a.a, a.b, b.a]`, indices `{2, 1, 0}`.
    - `aybx`: `a.b` coincides with `b.a` -> vertices ordered `[a.b, a.a, b.b]`, indices `{0, 1, 2}`.
    - `ayby`: `a.b` coincides with `b.b` -> vertices ordered `[a.b, a.a, b.a]`, indices `{0, 1, 2}`.
  - Appends face with `mesh.AppendFace(...)` using 3 position elements and 3 index elements.
- Case 2: Edges Are Disjoint (Bridge Forms a Quad):
  - Allocates 4-element arrays `Vector3[4] v`, `Color[4] c`, `int[4] s`.
  - Initializes `v[0] = positions[a.a]`, `s[0] = mesh.GetSharedVertexHandle(a.a)`, `v[1] = positions[a.b]`, `s[1] = mesh.GetSharedVertexHandle(a.b)`.
  - Twist & Planar Intersection Detection:
    - Calculates bridge plane normal: `Vector3 nrm = Vector3.Cross(positions[b.a] - positions[a.a], positions[a.b] - positions[a.a]).normalized`.
    - Projects the 4 points onto 2D plane: `Vector2[] planed = Projection.PlanarProject(new Vector3[4] {positions[a.a], positions[a.b], positions[b.a], positions[b.b]}, null, nrm)`.
    - Tests for diagonal crossing: `bool intersects = Math.GetLineSegmentIntersect(planed[0], planed[2], planed[1], planed[3], ref ipoint)`.
    - If `!intersects` (parallel layout): `v[2] = positions[b.a]`, `v[3] = positions[b.b]`.
    - If `intersects` (twisted layout): `v[2] = positions[b.b]`, `v[3] = positions[b.a]` (swaps edge `b` endpoints to untwist the quad).
  - Invokes `mesh.AppendFace(v, colors, uv0, uv2, uv3, new Face(new int[6] {2, 1, 0, 2, 3, 1}, submeshIndex, uvs, 0, -1, -1, false), s)` to construct two triangulated quad triangles.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, edge bridging connects two boundary edges of an `ArrayMesh` or `ImmediateMesh`. When edges share a vertex, a 3-vertex triangle is formed; when disjoint, 2D planar projection cross-testing resolves diagonal edge twist before generating the 4-vertex quad.

sections.heading: SUBDIVIDE EDGES
sections.content:
The `SubdivideEdges` menu action (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.SubdivideEdges`) and runtime method `AppendElements.AppendVerticesToEdge` (`UnityEngine.ProBuilder.MeshOperations.AppendElements`) divide selected edges into N evenly spaced segments by inserting intermediate vertices.

1. Settings & Preference Fields:
- Preference Keys and Constants:
  - `m_SubdivisionCount` (`Pref<int>`): key `"SubdivideEdges.subdivisions"`, default value `1`. Represents number of new vertices inserted per edge. Dividing into $N$ segments requires inserting $N-1$ points; when `subdivisions == 1`, edge is split in 2 segments.
  - `m_SubdivisionUIMin` (`Pref<int>`): key `"SubdivideEdges.subdivisionsUIMin"`, default value `1`.
  - `m_SubdivisionUIMax` (`Pref<int>`): key `"SubdivideEdges.subdivisionsUIMax"`, default value `32`.
  - `m_SubdivisionRangeExpanded` (`Pref<bool>`): key `"SubdivideEdges.rangeExpanded"`, default value `false`.
  - `const int m_SubdivisionMin = 1`.
  - `const int m_SubdivisionMax = 512`.
- UI Hierarchy:
  - Settings foldout displays `SliderInt` bound to `m_SubdivisionCount` with range `[m_SubdivisionUIMin, m_SubdivisionUIMax]`, paired with an `IntegerField` `m_SubdivCount`.
  - Expandable `Vector2IntField` `m_RangeField` exposes custom UI min/max range limits.

2. Editor Action Execution (`PerformActionImplementation`):
- Checks `MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount < 1` -> returns `ActionResult.NoSelection`.
- Registers undo state via `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Subdivide Edges")`.
- Iterates over `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
  - Calls `List<Edge> newEdgeSelection = AppendElements.AppendVerticesToEdge(pb, pb.selectedEdges, subdivisions)`.
  - If non-null: calls `pb.SetSelectedEdges(newEdgeSelection)`, `pb.ToMesh()`, `pb.Refresh()`, `pb.Optimize()`.
- Calls `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.

3. Runtime Splitting Algorithm (`AppendElements.AppendVerticesToEdge`):
- Method Signature: `public static List<Edge> AppendVerticesToEdge(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IList<Edge> edges, int count)`.
- Step 1 (Validation & Edge Deduplication):
  - Validates `mesh` and `edges` non-null; validates `count >= 1 && count <= 512`. Logs error and returns `null` if invalid.
  - Converts input edges to shared universal edges: `IEnumerable<Edge> commonEdges = EdgeUtility.GetSharedVertexHandleEdges(mesh, edges)`.
  - Deduplicates: `List<Edge> distinctEdges = commonEdges.Distinct().ToList()`.
  - Tracks `int originalSharedIndexesCount = lookup.Count`, `int sharedIndexesCount = originalSharedIndexesCount`, and `Dictionary<Face, FaceRebuildData> modifiedFaces`.
- Step 2 (Edge Point Generation & Adjacent Face Updating):
  - For each `Edge edge` in `distinctEdges`:
    - Retrieves local edge: `Edge localEdge = EdgeUtility.GetEdgeWithSharedVertexHandles(mesh, edge)`.
    - Generates `count` linearly interpolated vertices:
      `verticesToAppend.Add(Vertex.Mix(vertices[localEdge.a], vertices[localEdge.b], (i + 1) / ((float) count + 1)))` for `i = 0` to `count - 1`.
    - Obtains adjacent faces: `var adjacentFaces = ElementSelection.GetNeighborFaces(mesh, localEdge)`.
    - For each adjacent face tuple in `adjacentFaces`:
      - If face not yet in `modifiedFaces`: creates `FaceRebuildData`, sorts perimeter edges `peripheralEdges = WingedEdge.SortEdgesByAdjacency(face)`, and iterates around perimeter. When matching `edgeLookUp` forward (`a == a && b == b`), appends `verticesToAppend` in order ($0$ to $count-1$) with shared indices `sharedIndexesCount + j`. When matching backward (`a == b && b == a`), appends in reverse ($count-1$ down to $0$).
      - If face already in `modifiedFaces`: locates edge segment in `data.vertices` and inserts `verticesToAppend` with corresponding shared vertex indices.
    - Updates `sharedIndexesCount += count`.
- Step 3 (Retriangulation & Vertex Array Replacement):
  - For each modified face in `modifiedFaces`:
    - Triangulates new boundary vertices via `Triangulation.TriangulateVertices(data.vertices, out triangles, false)`.
    - Sets `data.face = new Face(triangles)`, preserves `submeshIndex`, and shifts vertex indices by `vertexCount`: `data.face.ShiftIndexes(vertexCount)`.
    - Copies face data: `face.CopyFrom(data.face)`.
    - Adds new indices to `lookup` and `lookupUV`.
    - Identifies all new edge segments where `common.a >= originalSharedIndexesCount || common.b >= originalSharedIndexesCount`, adding to `appendedEdges`.
  - Removes old un-split vertices: `mesh.DeleteVertices(indexesToDelete)`.
  - Updates mesh buffers: `mesh.SetVertices(vertices)`, `mesh.SetSharedVertices(lookup)`, `mesh.SetSharedTextures(lookupUV)`.
  - Returns `appendedEdges.Distinct().Select(x => x.local - delCount).ToList()` as the new edge selection.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, edge subdivision corresponds to inserting points along line segments in `MeshDataTool` or `SurfaceTool` and retriangulating adjacent polygons with Delaunay/ear-clipping triangulation.

sections.heading: SUBDIVIDE FACES
sections.content:
The `SubdivideFaces` menu action (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.SubdivideFaces`), `Subdivision.Subdivide` (`UnityEngine.ProBuilder.MeshOperations.Subdivision`), and `ConnectElements.Connect(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IEnumerable<Face> faces)` subdivide polygon faces by inserting a central centroid vertex and connecting it to the midpoints of all perimeter edges.

1. Editor Action Contract & Activation:
- Class: `SubdivideFaces : MenuAction` in namespace `UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions`.
- Properties:
  - `group`: returns `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`.
  - `iconPath`: returns `"Toolbar/Face_Subdivide"`.
  - `tooltip`: title `"Subdivide Faces"`, description `"Inserts a new vertex at the center of each selected face and creates a new edge from the center of each perimeter edge to the center vertex."`, shortcut `Alt/Opt + S` (`keyCommandAlt`, `'S'`).
  - `validSelectModes`: returns `SelectMode.Face`.
  - `enabled`: evaluated as `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount > 0`.
  - `hasFileMenuEntry`: returns `false`.
- Execution Pipeline (`PerformActionImplementation`):
  - Returns `ActionResult.NoSelection` if `MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount < 1`.
  - Calls `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Subdivide Faces")`.
  - Iterates through `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
    - Calls `Face[] faces = pb.Subdivide(pb.selectedFacesInternal)`.
    - Invokes `pb.ToMesh()`.
    - If `faces != null`: updates face selection with `pb.SetSelectedFaces(faces)`, calls `pb.Refresh()`, `pb.Optimize()`.
  - Invokes `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.

2. Subdivision API Pipeline:
- Method `Subdivision.Subdivide(this ProBuilderMesh pb)`: calls `pb.Subdivide(pb.facesInternal)`.
- Method `Subdivision.Subdivide(this ProBuilderMesh pb, IList<Face> faces)`: redirects to `ConnectElements.Connect(pb, faces)`.
- Method `ConnectElements.Connect(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IEnumerable<Face> faces)`:
  - Validates face triangulation: `var split = MeshValidation.EnsureFacesAreComposedOfContiguousTriangles(mesh, faces)`.
  - Collects mask of target faces: `HashSet<Face> mask = new HashSet<Face>(faces)`.
  - Extracts all perimeter edges: `IEnumerable<Edge> edges = mask.SelectMany(x => x.edgesInternal)`.
  - Delegates to `ConnectElements.Connect(mesh, edges, out res, out empty, true, false, mask)`.

3. Quad vs N-gon Face Subdividing Algorithm:
- When `ConnectElements.Connect` receives all edges of a face, `targetEdges.Count` equals the number of perimeter edges $N$.
- Centroid Calculation:
  `Vertex centroid = Vertex.Average(vertices, face.distinctIndexesInternal)` computes the arithmetic mean of all vertex positions and attributes on the face.
- Quad Face ($N = 4$):
  - `splitCount = 4`.
  - `ConnectEdgesInFace` walks perimeter edges sorted by adjacency.
  - At each of the 4 edges, splits at `mix = Vertex.Mix(v_a, v_b, 0.5f)`.
  - Assembles 4 separate quad polygons: each sub-face contains `[v_original, mix_edge, centroid, mix_previous_edge]`.
  - Result: 1 quad face is subdivided into exactly 4 smaller quad faces.
- Triangle Face ($N = 3$):
  - `splitCount = 3`.
  - Centroid vertex is inserted in the triangle center; edge midpoints are inserted on all 3 perimeter edges.
  - Generates 3 quad faces meeting at the center vertex (Catmull-Clark style quad conversion).
- N-gon Face ($N > 4$):
  - `splitCount = N`.
  - Sorts perimeter with `WingedEdge.SortEdgesByAdjacency(face)`.
  - Subdivides all $N$ perimeter edges at their midpoints and connects each to `centroid`.
  - Result: produces $N$ quad sub-faces radiating symmetrically around the central vertex, converting arbitrary $N$-gons into all-quad topology.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, face subdivision creates Catmull-Clark style center-split quads. For any polygon with $N$ vertices, computing the polygon center and splitting all $N$ boundary edges produces $N$ quad polygons sharing the center vertex.

sections.heading: INSERT EDGE LOOP
sections.content:
The `InsertEdgeLoop` menu action (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.InsertEdgeLoop`) detects continuous quad strips encircling a mesh and inserts a perpendicular edge loop splitting each quad in the strip.

1. Editor Action Contract & Activation:
- Class: `InsertEdgeLoop : MenuAction` in namespace `UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions`.
- Properties:
  - `group`: returns `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`.
  - `iconPath`: returns `"Toolbar/Edge_InsertLoop"`.
  - `tooltip`: title `"Insert Edge Loop"`, summary `"Connects all edges in a ring around the object."`, shortcut `Alt/Opt + U` (`keyCommandAlt`, `'U'`).
  - `validSelectModes`: returns `SelectMode.Edge`.
  - `enabled`: evaluated as `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCount > 0`.
- Execution Pipeline (`PerformActionImplementation`):
  - Returns `ActionResult.NoSelection` if `MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount < 1`.
  - Calls `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Insert Edge Loop")`.
  - Iterates over `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
    - Evaluates edge ring: `IEnumerable<Edge> ring = ElementSelection.GetEdgeRing(pb, pb.selectedEdges)`.
    - Inserts seam edges: `Edge[] edges = pb.Connect(ring).item2`.
    - If `edges != null`: selects the newly generated loop edges with `pb.SetSelectedEdges(edges)`, calls `pb.ToMesh()`, `pb.Refresh()`, `pb.Optimize()`.
  - Invokes `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.

2. Ring Detection Algorithm (`ElementSelection.GetEdgeRing`):
- Method Signature: `internal static IEnumerable<Edge> GetEdgeRing(ProBuilderMesh pb, IEnumerable<Edge> edges)`.
- Step 1 (Winged Edge Graph Initialization):
  - Generates winged edge topology: `List<WingedEdge> wings = WingedEdge.GetWingedEdges(pb)`.
  - Resolves distinct lookup edges: `edgeLookup = EdgeLookup.GetEdgeLookup(edges, pb.sharedVertexLookup).Distinct().ToList()`.
  - Maps common edges to wings: `Dictionary<Edge, WingedEdge> wings_dic`.
- Step 2 (Bi-directional Strip Traversal):
  - For each input edge in `edgeLookup`:
    - Locates starting wing `we` from `wings_dic[edgeLookup[i].common]`.
    - Forward Walk:
      - `cur = we;`
      - `while (cur != null)`: adds `cur.edge` to `HashSet<EdgeLookup> used`; if already present, breaks loop (detecting closed ring cycle).
      - Steps across quad: `cur = EdgeRingNext(cur)`.
      - Crosses to adjacent face: `if (cur != null && cur.opposite != null) cur = cur.opposite`.
    - Backward Walk:
      - Starts from `cur = EdgeRingNext(we.opposite); if (cur != null && cur.opposite != null) cur = cur.opposite`.
      - Walks backward along the ring strip until reaching a boundary or visited edge.
  - Returns `used.Select(x => x.local)`.

3. Quad Strip Traversal & Non-Quad Termination (`EdgeRingNext`):
- Implementation (`ElementSelection.EdgeRingNext(WingedEdge edge)`):
  - If `edge == null`, returns `null`.
  - Initializes `WingedEdge next = edge.next, prev = edge.previous; int i = 0;`.
  - Traversal loop:
    - Steps `next = next.next;`
    - If `next == prev`, returns `null` immediately.
    - Steps `prev = prev.previous;`
    - Increments `i++;`
  - Termination condition: `if (i % 2 == 0 || next == edge) next = null;` returns `next`.
- Behavior in Quad Polygons (4 perimeter edges):
  - Edge 0 is input. `next` = Edge 1, `prev` = Edge 3.
  - Step 1: `next` advances to Edge 2 (opposite edge). `prev` retreats to Edge 2.
  - Loop condition `next != prev` evaluates to false (`Edge 2 == Edge 2`). Loop ends.
  - Check: `i = 1` (odd) and `next != edge`. Returns `Edge 2`.
  - Traversal successfully identifies the opposite parallel edge across the quad.
- Behavior in Triangles, Pentagons, and N-gons:
  - Triangle (3 edges): `next` (Edge 1) advances to Edge 2; `prev` is Edge 2. Condition `next == prev` triggers immediately, returning `null`.
  - Pentagon (5 edges): on step 2, `next` meets `prev` inside loop, returning `null`.
  - Hexagon (6 edges): loop completes after 2 steps with `i = 2` (even). Condition `i % 2 == 0` evaluates true, setting `next = null`.
  - Mesh Boundaries: when reaching a boundary edge with no opposite wing (`cur.opposite == null`), traversal stops.
  - Consequence: Edge loop traversal strictly follows quad topology strips and cleanly terminates whenever encountering any non-quad polygon or open boundary.

4. Loop Insertion via `pb.Connect(ring)`:
- Calling `pb.Connect(ring)` passes the collected ring edges to `ConnectElements.Connect`.
- Each quad in the ring strip has two opposite edges selected.
- `ConnectElements.Connect` executes `ConnectEdgesInFace(face, targetEdges[0], targetEdges[1], vertices)` on each quad, splitting each quad into two new quads and creating a connecting edge along the midpoints.
- The returned `item2` collection of newly inserted edges forms the continuous edge loop.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, edge loop insertion is implemented by finding the edge ring through half-edge or winged-edge traversal across quad polygons (stepping `next.next` and crossing `opposite`), then splitting each quad face into two sub-polygons along the midpoint bisector.

sections.heading: SMART CONNECT/SUBDIVIDE
sections.content:
The `SmartConnect` (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.SmartConnect`) and `SmartSubdivide` (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions.SmartSubdivide`) actions implement mode-aware dispatch logic, binding unified keyboard shortcuts (`Alt/Opt + E` and `Alt/Opt + S`) to selection-mode-specific geometry operations.

1. Smart Connect (`SmartConnect`):
- Class: `SmartConnect : MenuAction` in namespace `UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions`.
- Properties:
  - `group`: returns `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`.
  - `iconPath`: returns `string.Empty`, `icon`: returns `null`.
  - `tooltip`: title `"Smart Connect"`, summary `""`, shortcut `Alt/Opt + E` (`keyCommandAlt`, `'E'`).
  - `validSelectModes`: returns `SelectMode.Vertex | SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face`.
  - `enabled`: evaluated as `base.enabled && (MeshSelection.selectedVertexCount > 1 || MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCount > 1 || MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount > 1)`.
  - `hidden`: returns `true` (hidden from toolbar icons to avoid duplication; serves as the global shortcut routing action).
- Dispatch Logic (`PerformActionImplementation`):
  - Evaluates `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode`:
    - `case SelectMode.Vertex`: invokes `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<ConnectVertices>().PerformAction()`.
    - `default` (`SelectMode.Edge` or `SelectMode.Face`): invokes `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<ConnectEdges>().PerformAction()`.

2. Smart Subdivide (`SmartSubdivide`):
- Class: `SmartSubdivide : MenuAction` in namespace `UnityEditor.ProBuilder.Actions`.
- Properties:
  - `group`: returns `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`.
  - `iconPath`: returns `string.Empty`, `icon`: returns `null`.
  - `tooltip`: title `"Smart Subdivide"`, summary `""`, shortcut `Alt/Opt + S` (`keyCommandAlt`, `'S'`).
  - `validSelectModes`: returns `SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face`.
  - `enabled`: evaluated as `base.enabled && (MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCount > 0 || MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount > 0)`.
  - `hidden`: returns `true`.
- Dispatch Logic (`PerformActionImplementation`):
  - Evaluates `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode`:
    - `case SelectMode.Edge`: invokes `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<SubdivideEdges>().PerformAction()`.
    - `default` (`SelectMode.Face`): invokes `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<SubdivideFaces>().PerformAction()`.
- Menu Item Code Generation (`GetMenuItemOverride`):
  - Returns C# code block string configuring `EditorAction.Start(new MenuActionSettings(...))` for Unity menu integration based on `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4 editor plugins, smart dispatch actions are implemented via input event shortcuts (`_unhandled_key_input`) that query the active sub-element editing mode (Vertex, Edge, Face) and route command execution to the corresponding tool action.
